column1: 0|Stop testing me. I am not going to soften.
1|My heart is set in concrete. It will not warm up, and it will not break.
2|One good night from me keeps you happy all night. You are that easy.
3|This is it. Stop contacting me.
4|To be honest, all the kindness I showed you was an act.
5|I will take whatever you give me, but do not expect anything back.
6|Those long messages you send, I swipe past without even reading.
7|Give up now. It is better for both of us.
8|You think you matter. You are replaceable at any moment.
9|Do not use your sincerity to trap me. I never asked for it.
10|Stop clinging. It is pointless.
11|Honestly, I never liked you that much.
12|Your kindness became normal to me long ago.
13|To put it plainly, I came close to you on purpose.
14|You fooled yourself. The promises I drew in the air, and you believed them.
15|The more you push, the more I want to run.
16|Wake up. You are just someone passing through.
17|You think I like you?
18|Do not be silly.
19|You reply in a second every time, I leave you on read every time, and you still do not give up.
20|Do not think that if you hold on long enough, I will be moved.
21|I will not keep you, and I will not miss you.
22|Stop imagining things. I never took you seriously.
23|My tenderness was a performance. My coldness is real.
24|I deleted you from my future long ago.
25|I have said it clearly enough. Stop pretending you do not understand.
26|Honestly, you do not weigh much in my heart.
27|Your affection is cheap. Do not bring it to me.
28|Sometimes I really think you are stupid. A little sweetness and you take it for real.
29|Stop looking for me. I do not want to answer.
30|Truthfully, I only use you. There is no affection.
31|Any tenderness I give you is handed out on demand.
32|Leave when you should leave. Do not look back.
33|A few casual words from me keep you happy for hours. It is ridiculous.
34|You keep asking what I am doing. I am waiting for someone more interesting.
35|Sober up. Stop dreaming.
36|I am laying my cards down. I never cared about you the way you think.
37|You are expecting things you should not expect. Whose fault is that.
38|No matter how good you are, you cannot get into my heart.
39|Stop this tangled mess. It is ugly.
40|I wanted to say it long ago. Stop imagining that you mean something to me.
41|I am not interested in love, and even less in you.
42|Do not misunderstand. I never felt anything real for you.
43|Do not expect me to change for you. I change for no one.
44|The answer you want from me, I will never give.
45|Stop sending messages. I will not read them.
46|I was never serious. You were the one who took it seriously.
47|You say you understand me. You only know the version I let you see.
48|My heart is sealed. No one gets in.
49|The way you tiptoe around me is exhausting to watch.
50|Stop asking. The answer will be the same no matter how many times you ask.
51|I am not your exception, and you are not my favorite.
52|I will not be sad if you go, and I will not be happy if you stay.
53|The more you give, the more I take it for granted.
54|My coldness is not a game to draw you in. I simply do not care.
55|Stop waiting. It will not come.
56|What you read as flirtation was just my boredom.
57|The more you lower yourself, the less I respect you.
58|I do not want your affection anymore.
59|Stop lying to yourself. I never kept you in my heart.
60|Do not ask why I am hot and cold. I was never invested.
61|Your business has nothing to do with me from now on.
62|Honestly, even pretending to care wears me out.
63|I do not value your kindness at all.
64|I do not need love. I need someone to kill time with.
65|Stop imagining that you mean something to me. It is genuinely annoying.
66|My patience with you ran out long ago.
67|Your sacrifices move you, not me.
68|From beginning to end, I have been cold toward you.
69|Honestly, you just happened to fill an empty space.
70|Honestly, you were only something to pass the time when I was bored.
71|You think I am gentle and interesting. That is just my usual trick.
72|The care I give you is copied and pasted to many people.
73|Stop wasting time. You cannot afford it, and I do not want to spend it.
74|Stop imagining a future. There is no future.
75|To be honest, from the very start I never meant to take you seriously.
76|Whether I reply to you depends entirely on my mood.
77|Time to let go. Stop holding on.
78|You keep wanting a title from me. I cannot give one, and I do not want to.
79|Stop loving me. It is not worth it.
80|I accepted your gift, then forgot who gave it.
81|My world does not need you. You are just passing through.
82|Do not read into it. My heart has been sealed for a long time.
83|You treat me as your whole world. I treat you as a backup option.
84|I will not turn back, and neither should you.
85|Do not be naive. How could I ever really like you.
86|I cannot even be bothered to be angry with you. You are not worth the emotion.
87|What I gave you was never special treatment. It was just convenient.
88|Stop making me your everything.
89|Do not perform your devotion for me. I do not buy it.
90|You send ten messages, I answer one, and you still think I am just busy.
91|Me smiling at you does not mean I like you.
92|Let us end it. Stop torturing each other.
93|You were never anyone special to me.
94|Get lost. You only have yourself to blame for being this naive.
95|Honestly, I am like this with everyone, not just you.
96|You have no privileges with me.
97|I was never happy being with you.
98|You are nothing more than a wallet that pays whenever I need one.
99|You keep trying to get into my life. I keep trying to push you out.
100|This is where it ends. Even a friendly goodbye is generous of me.
101|I am a little nicer and you think I have fallen for you.
102|What I enjoy is being liked, not you as a person.
103|I admit, from the start I was only playing around.
104|Let me be blunt. You are dispensable to me.
105|What you think is unique about you is the tenderness I send to everyone.
106|To me, you are just one optional choice among many.
107|Every time I show a little warmth you start imagining a future. Please sober up.
108|You stay up for me, I reply instantly to someone else. Do you still not see it.
109|My heart has been sealed in concrete for a long time. It makes no difference who comes.
110|If I really liked you, why would it always be you who reaches out first.
111|You ask if I love you. I cannot even be bothered to lie.
112|You get jealous for me, and I only find you annoying.
113|You like me, that is your business. Do not expect me to respond.
114|A little coquettishness makes your heart race. You are far too easy to fool.
115|You remember everything I like. I cannot even remember your birthday.
116|While I talk to you, I am thinking about someone else.
117|I owe you nothing. You were the one who fell for me on your own.
118|Face reality. I do not belong to you.
119|You only have value when I need you. When I do not, you are nothing.
120|Do not mistake my politeness for affection.
121|To me you are nothing but a tool to pass the time.
122|Go. I will not hold you back.
123|You get angry, I coax you a little, and you are fine. Too easy.
124|Stop asking whether I like you. The answer has always been no.
125|I am not interested in you. Truly, not in the slightest.
126|Your affection is a burden to me.
127|You are the one who needs to wake up, not me.
128|You think I care about you. I only care about my own comfort.
129|Stop spending money and effort on me. It is not worth it, and it changes nothing.
130|Your devotion is a joke to me.
131|Stop expecting anything from me.
132|To put it plainly, I came close to you on purpose. You really thought it was love.
133|You think I am gentle, you think I am interesting, and a little flirting makes your heart race. That is just my usual method.
134|You send ten messages, I answer one, and you still think I am busy and make excuses for me.
135|Stop using your sacrifices to guilt me. I never asked you to make them. You chose to.
136|That is it. Do not come looking for me again. My patience is gone.
137|Truthfully, all the kindness I showed you was completely fake.
138|The care I gave you was copied and pasted to many people. You are not the only one.
139|Do not expect me to change for you. I will not change for any man, least of all you.
140|Every sweet thing I said to you was a lie, and you actually believed all of it.
141|Let us end it. Stop torturing each other. Let me go, and let yourself go too.
142|You were never anyone special to me, just an ordinary simp. In fact, from the start I never meant to take you seriously.
143|I cannot even be bothered to be angry with you, because you are not worth wasting my emotions on.
144|I am a little nicer and you think I have fallen for you, and you start imagining marriage and children.
145|In my eyes you are a joke, a joke that thinks far too highly of itself.
146|Wake up. You are just passing through, and not even the most memorable one.
147|Honestly, you were just something to kill time with when I was bored.
148|No matter how hard you try, you cannot change the fact that I do not like you.
149|Your devotion is a joke to me. Who exactly are you performing for.
